mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level at the time of signal indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index value above 300 (indicating elevated inflation) triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return signal over the next 20 trading days, as high inflation pressures central banks to tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%) combined with strong industrial production (INDPRO > 102.5) signals robust economic growth, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5 AND INDPRO > 102.5, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (GDPC1 growth rate < 0.0% year-over-year), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 0.0% year-over-year and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1300 thousand units) indicates robust consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production level (INDPRO > 103.0) signals strong supply-side economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 103.0.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicates a tight labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5.
